description_en: Queries all signatures under your account, allowing you to view signature details, including the signature approval status, signature type, and signature name
description_zh: 可以通过此接口可以查询您账号下的所有签名，方便您查看签名详情，包括签名审核状态、签名类型、签名名称等
name: QuerySmsSignList

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.help_en: The number of signatures displayed per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的签名个数。默认取值为10，取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size
